purpose: Check every named booklet case/example for omitted useful evidence and correct scope/date errors while preserving readable grouped explanations.

Salford Quays.booklet_claims: Cotton, manufacturing, ship canal; 3,000 jobs lost in 1960s; closure 1982
Salford Quays.decision: Add cotton and 1894 canal opening; retain 1982 closure. Do not conflate undated job losses with a particular decade.
Added £64m National Lottery grant, not total regeneration cost; date retained.
Added five departments/Sport; relocation begins 2011. £550m phase-cost claim has no clear scope in booklet; do not treat it as BBC relocation expenditure.
Include as early five-year PROJECTED benefits, not measured net additional outcomes.

Salford Quays.booklet_claims: Homes, services, parks, cleaned waterways, tram
Salford Quays.decision: Integrated under regeneration/effects; merge duplicate multiplier/transport explanation.

Leeds.decision: Retain dated 2021 census 812,000/8.1% and ethnic breakdown; undated percentages not presented as current.

Leeds.booklet_claims: Caribbean, Indian, Pakistani, Irish, Polish and Lithuanian migration; 30,000 students
Leeds.decision: Retain international/national migration and student mechanisms; strengthen Carnival with 1967. Do not infer all migrant groups share low pay or one neighbourhood. Student/Irish totals need date and definition.
Do not label city-region figures as Leeds city; retain city employment evidence. Hospital/site total needs dated boundary.

Leeds.booklet_claims: ASDA; creative industry; Tour de France; sports
Leeds.decision: Retain service/creative economy and add Holbeck named setting. Sports/culture are useful examples but do not substitute for challenge/response evidence.

Leeds.booklet_claims: 24,000 waiting list; 18% commute; waste 150,000t/44%; JSA 15% vs 0.2%
Leeds.decision: Booklet lacks dates/definitions: retain sourced dated housing, poverty and PIPES figures instead of asserting these as current.

Leeds.booklet_claims: HS2 81-minute journey; South Bank; Holbeck; walking/cycling; education
Leeds.decision: Add South Bank/Holbeck regeneration links. Do not present the old HS2 Leeds proposal as a delivered or current committed scheme.

source_links: Primary and supporting verification links are listed in the canonical notes; school-booklet climate approximations retain their approximate status.
presentation: Short explanatory paragraphs with bold lead-ins; no duplicated summary bullets before expanded prose. Preserve comparison tables, useful diagrams and genuine method/process lists.
